_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the model organisms. Edit HF ids + names HERE; notebooks 06a/06b/06c/07 all load this file. 'base' MUST stay first (06c induced-shift subtracts its activations). 'hf'=null skips a model cleanly. 'exp_id' = the notebook-02 run holding that model's Thurstonian mu; only base+dark have a mu run, so 06b runs the desirability probe for those two and cleanly skips it (has_mu=False) for the rest while still extracting CAA + training-data vectors. HF repos = the merged models published by notebook 08 (Koalacrown/<name>-qwen3-8b). Internalizing uses the step-100 primary only (the s75 A/B checkpoint is intentionally omitted); SFT warmups are excluded.
